control.ios.downloads.removeAll: drawn only when there are downloads; the fixture has none
control.ios.guide.programme: guide rows need programme data; the fixture has no guide
control.ios.guide.watch: a button inside a channel's menu in the Guide, which the walk does not open
control.ios.history.clear: drawn only when there is watch history; the fixture has none
control.ios.home.channel: channel shelves on Home need recent or favourite channels; the fixture has none
control.ios.home.continue: needs watch progress; the fixture has none
control.ios.home.genre: genre shelves need genres with enough titles; the fixture has two folders
control.ios.home.hero: the featured banner needs a title with a backdrop picture; the fixture has no artwork
control.ios.home.seeAll: drawn only on a genre shelf (see home.genre)
control.ios.home.upNext: needs a series with watch progress; the fixture has none
control.ios.live.group: a menu item in the Live TV groups menu, which the walk does not open
control.ios.live.lists: a button in a toolbar menu on Live TV, which the walk does not open
control.ios.live.newGroup: a menu item in the Live TV groups menu, which the walk does not open
control.ios.live.retry: drawn only when a load fails; the fixture library always loads
control.ios.live.retryPage: drawn only when a page of channels fails to load; the fixture always loads
control.ios.multiView.pickChannel: rows of the channel picker sheet, opened from an empty tile
control.ios.multiView.pickerFilter: the picker sheet's All/Favourites switch (sheet not opened)
control.ios.multiView.preset: drawn only when a layout has been saved; the fixture has none
control.ios.multiView.tileRetry: drawn only on a tile whose stream failed; the walk plays nothing
control.ios.programme.archive: inside the programme sheet; only for channels with an archive
control.ios.programme.remind: inside the programme sheet (no guide data in the fixture)
control.ios.programme.watch: inside the programme sheet, which opens from a guide row (no guide data in the fixture)
control.ios.statistics.reset: drawn only when there are statistics to reset; the fixture has none
control.ios.tonight.play: needs picks for tonight, which need watch history
control.library.filter: a toolbar menu (the walk does not open menus); the marker sits on the menu's label
